order: Their recent form has also been poor. On the 27th of last month, China also suffered a 0-3 crushing defeat in a home match against New Zealand (ranked 86th). They conceded eight goals in two matches and failed to score a single one.

In terms of match performance, Palestine dominated China. While China trailed slightly in possession at 46%-54%, there was a significant gap in shots on target, with the score being 3-9. Total shots also favored Palestine at 12-16. The difference was evident from the quality of their attacks.

China's Sina.com reported the shocking result as "the first defeat in 60 years." After defeating Palestine 7-0 in their first encounter in 1966, China had not lost any of their head-to-head matches up until this game, holding a record of five wins and two draws.
He also expressed regret over the team's overall focus. Coach Xiao Zai pointed out, "It seems some players were still thinking about the league or the AFC Champions League."

Coach Xiao Zai said, "From 1998 to now, I have lived for almost 30 years as a player and coach, experiencing both victories and defeats. Defeat is part of football, so it must be accepted," but added, "Honestly, I have never experienced this kind of defeat before."
However, collapsing at home with a 0-5 loss, they suffered the humiliation of their first-ever defeat against Palestine.
The Chinese men's national football team suffered a 0-5 rout in a friendly match against Palestine held on the 2nd at Longxing Football Field in Chongqing, China.

At the press conference, Coach Xiao Zai bowed his head, saying, "I am sorry for losing by such a score difference," and added, "There is nothing more to explain. This kind of match is difficult for both me and the team to accept."
